text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking down the hallway, I ran into 
Inari One heading somewhere with a plastic 
shopping bag.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well fancy meeting you here, Boss. This? 
These are ingredients for lunch. I'm on my 
way to the home ec room to whip something 
up.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Big Sis, fancy meeting you here. This? 
It's ingredients for lunch. I'm just about 
to head to the home ec room and whip 
something up!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I've gained some weight 
lately... So I tried eating low-carb soba, 
but man, it's just about the blandest 
thing ever.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
So I thought to myself, why not just hit 
it outta the park on my own?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Make soba that suits my own taste. Plus, 
making soba from scratch burns calories. 
It's a two-birds-one-stone diet method, ya 
see!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: How about it, pal, wanna try some too?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: How about it, Sis, wanna try some too?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Inari One continued her soba-making diet 
after that and successfully got back into 
shape.
